title: Evaluate usable outputs
summary: Separate first-pass usability, repaired acceptance and errors that validation misses.

sections.label: Different checks
rows: Parsing, schema, supported components and compatibility.
The artifact represents the requirements and works on agreed examples.
Incomplete/unsupported inputs produce intended clarification or failure.

sections.label: Schema validity is insufficient
sections.text: OpenAI documents remaining mistakes in structured outputs. A schema-valid mapping or value can still be wrong; domain checks evaluate a different property.

sections.label: Initial case design
items: Reuse existing reviewed examples and manual checks.
Keep representative workload cases separate from diagnostic cases selected to expose failures.
Include incomplete, conflicting and unsupported inputs with expected behaviour.
Allow equivalent correct artifacts rather than requiring one exact byte sequence.
Reserve untouched comparison examples where evidence permits; group related reference families/revisions to reduce leakage.
Repeat selected cases when variability could change the decision.

sections.label: Separate outcomes
rows: Accepted before human or repair-loop correction.
Include attempts, latency and engineer correction effort.
No usable output under the trial policy.
Independent review found a validation gap; classify consequence.

sections.label: Criteria and limitations
sections.text: Product/domain and technical owners define usability and unacceptable errors. The generator's success claim is insufficient. Model grading is optional and needs reviewed calibration. State sample counts/coverage; a small chosen set does not guarantee production reliability. No arbitrary acceptance percentage or sample size is supplied here.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended use: Plan and inspect mechanical, meaning and interaction checks for the study's actual artifacts.
Demonstrate a format-valid but semantically wrong candidate is rejected by an independent check.
Separate first-pass acceptance, repaired acceptance and rejected or unresolved outcomes.
Workflow placement and checks are Atlas recommendations. Existing examples, tenant availability, older product claims and comparative benefits were not revalidated by this mapping review.

basis: Ticket-scoped recommendation; not an implemented workplace capability
confidence: Moderate for fit; workplace benefit unknown

catalog.applicability: Use this when a study must judge whether generated artifacts are usable and not only schema valid. Separate first-pass usable, usable after repair, rejected and incorrect but passed checks, and let product and technical owners define usability and unacceptable errors.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
